PROVENANCE OF THE DECOMPOSITION, ANSWERED FROM THE RECORD 2026-08-31, because Anthony asked how the ten subsystems were arrived at and whether they were defined independent of the actual structure.

═══ ① THE SE PROCESS EXISTS AND IS RECORDED. IT WAS ALSO ACCRETIVE. ═══
2026-07-23 — `dec:bl83a-functional-decomposition`, ACCEPTED, "derived with the user". Its rationale is the answer to the question: the self-model HAD been recovered backwards from the file tree, so its 38 Components were the Rust module list and the domain primitives a design-graph product fundamentally IS — node and edge types — appeared nowhere (BL-83). The replacement was carved from PURPOSE: "the functional systems a design-graph tool IS". The rationale states the principle explicitly: "A functional carving comes from the product's purpose (a genesis input), NOT the code, and cuts across crate boundaries, so adopt on the code can only re-derive the module view."

⭐ SO THE ANSWER TO "WERE THEY DEFINED INDEPENDENT OF THE STRUCTURE?" IS YES, DELIBERATELY, WITH A STATED REASON — and structure-derived was not an unconsidered alternative but the state being escaped from.

THE COUNT THEN ACCRETED, four amendments on one node:
    7   as first written
    8   2026-08-02  arithmetic correction (documentation had joined; prose said seven, scan_nodes said eight)
    9   2026-08-20  sys:foundation CREATED — "the carving itself moved"
   10   2026-08-20  cmp:packaging promoted from leaf to subsystem, same day

═══ ② AND THE SHAPE MOVED A FIFTH TIME WITHOUT THE DECISION FOLLOWING ═══
2026-08-25 — `dec:the-two-oversized-subsystems-are-split-functionally`, ACCEPTED on his word against recorded alternatives: sys:coherence-loop 28 children → 5, sys:agent-surface 25 → 5, both PROMOTED to `level: system` to make the rung. `dec:bl83a-functional-decomposition` still describes a flat ten and was never amended for it.

MEASURED ON THE COMMITTED EXPORT TODAY:
    level=system      2   sys:coherence-loop, sys:agent-surface
    level=subsystem  18   8 originals at root + the 10 sub:* under those two
    level=component  86
    level=part        2
    multiple_parents  0   hierarchy_issues 0

Of the ten the decision names, EIGHT are at `level: subsystem` and TWO are at `level: system`. They are not peers in the graph and the decision says they are.

🛑 THE RECONCILIATION FAILURE IS IN THE PROSE, NOT IN THE SPINE. Every sub:* has exactly one parent, no component has two, and hierarchy_issues is zero — the structure is coherent and was changed deliberately. What is stale is the decision TEXT. This is the FOURTH stale record found in one session, after the parallel-batch finding, the optimize decision, and the Interface/VERIFIES fact.

═══ ③ THE ILITY-DRIVEN CUT HAS ALREADY BEEN MADE ONCE, AND IT IS RECORDED AS SUCH ═══
The coherence-loop split was not arbitrary grouping. Its own words: "SEPARATING FINDING FROM TELLING IS THE OBSERVABILITY CUT, and it is why this grouping and not another... Observability-driven allocation wants THE INSTRUMENT SEPARATED FROM THE SUBJECT — a part that finds a problem must not be the part that decides how loudly to report it. THE QUALITY TARGET WAS NOT DECORATION; IT PICKED THE CUT."

⇒ That is `dec:idea-the-ility-chooses-the-allocation-graph` exercised on a real carving. The ility→graph direction that node says "does not exist" HAS been used once, by hand, and nobody linked the two.

═══ ④ AND THE CODE-DERIVED SPINE WAS OFFERED AND DECLINED, WITH THE ARTEFACT IN HAND ═══
The same 2026-08-25 decision records it: adopt HAD recovered the module hierarchy, its top tier was `cmp:crate-reflow2-core` and `cmp:crate-reflow2-mcp` — CRATES — and it was deliberately not applied, because "applying it would have replaced a functional carving with a structural one and overturned dec:bl83a-functional-decomposition. A functional over-span wants a functional answer; the module view stays evidence, never a replacement spine."

⚠️ WHAT THIS FACT DOES NOT SETTLE, and it is the live question: whether that call should now be REVERSED. It measures what was decided and why, not whether it was right. Today's separate measurement — 45 of 88 core modules adding methods to one shared DesignGraph struct — bears on it directly and was not available in July or August.
